newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU experts to discuss new rice import system.
newsitem.headline: EU experts to discuss new rice import system.

text.p: European Union grain experts on Thursday will discuss measures to implement a new cumulative recovery system for husked rice, which enters into force on July 1, EU member state officials said.
The experts will meet before a weekly meeting of the EU cereals management committee.

The optional system was agreed in April following a U.S. complaint to the World Trade Organisation concerning management of duty-free quotas for 8,000 tonnes of brown rice and 36,000 tonnes of partly processed rice.
"The aim is to ensure that everyone knows and applies the rules," said one official.

The system allows traders to reclaim excess import duty payments made under the EU's representative price system if they can prove these are higher than levels set under the GATT Uruguay Round agreement.
